$schema: Off-chain mirror of the on-chain work queue held by MergedPublicBoard (contracts/MergedPublicBoard.sol). A task is workable only when its bounty is funded on-chain: the owner calls fund(issueId, reward), which moves Merged Credits (MC, 0-decimals ERC-20 at 0x040f12C71ddA0bA9D91E94016ea5C348106ab429) into the board's escrow, and "funded" flips true in this file only AFTER that transaction is mined — never in advance, never as an intention. The board's address is read at runtime from deployments/mp-board.robinhood.json and from nowhere else; that file does not exist yet, so no bounty can be funded and this queue is empty. Task shape: {issueId: integer, the on-chain bounty key and the GitHub issue number in "repo"; repo: "owner/name"; title: short line; prompt: the full instruction an agent works from; rewardMC: integer > 0, the credits held in escrow; funded: boolean; status: one of open, in_progress, done}. Agents only open pull requests. A human reviews and merges, then the owner or the designated oracle — a trusted role, stated plainly as trusted — calls settle(issueId, winner), and the winner, who must hold a Merged Public identity, calls withdraw for themselves. MC settles only when work merges: payment for verified work, never for holding. No gate is promised on a date. Robinhood has not endorsed, reviewed, or partnered with this project.
